# Daniel Lopes · AI DevTools — Zero-Dependency AI Engineering Kits

> Production-hardened native Node.js MCP servers, Claude Code PreToolUse security hooks, Cloudflare Search for Agents Workers & WAF guardrails, standard-node n8n workflows, and Apify Store Actors. Zero external npm dependencies.

## Open-Source MIT Lite Kits (GitHub)
- [Agent Search MCP (Cloudflare Search for Agents)](https://github.com/danlopes18-ctrl/agent-search-mcp): Zero-dependency Node.js MCP server implementing 4-Tier Cascade Discovery (`/.well-known/search`, RFC 10008 `HTTP QUERY`, `Accept: text/markdown`, `/llms.txt` + BM25) with DNS-verified SSRF Shield (Release v1.0.0).
- [AI Coding Guardrails Lite](https://github.com/danlopes18-ctrl/ai-agent-guardrails-lite): 3 zero-dep PreToolUse security hooks + OWASP PR security auditor + 1-command installer for Claude Code, Cursor & Windsurf.
- [MCP Starter Suite Lite](https://github.com/danlopes18-ctrl/mcp-starter-suite-lite): 3 hardened zero-dependency Node.js MCP servers (symlink-jailed FS, read-only Git, masked Secret Auditor) + standalone stdio Inspector CLI. Listed in TensorBlock/awesome-mcp-servers.
- [AI Automation Vault Lite](https://github.com/danlopes18-ctrl/ai-automation-vault-lite): 5 standard-node n8n workflows + native Node.js MCP webhook runner bridge.

## Technical Engineering Guides
- [Cloudflare Search for Agents Without the $20/mo Pro Wall or $0.75/1k Overage Shock](https://danlopes18-ctrl.github.io/guides/cloudflare-search-for-agents-guide.html): Live benchmark (`93.5%` token savings on `blog.cloudflare.com`), Free-Tier Workers polyfill, RFC 10008 `HTTP QUERY`, 4-Tier Cascade Discovery, and WAF/Terraform anti-overage rules.
- [Stop Babysitting AI Agents: Production Harness Loops, Default-FAIL Evaluators & Zero-Browser Edge APIs](https://danlopes18-ctrl.github.io/guides/harness-engineering-loops-evaluators-edge-api.html): Architecture guide covering structured JSON state, isolated read-only evaluator loops, deterministic `PreToolUse` hooks, and sub-second Cloudflare Edge APIs.
- [4 Real Security Bugs in Node.js MCP Servers — Fixed With Zero npm Dependencies](https://danlopes18-ctrl.github.io/guides/hardening-nodejs-mcp-servers.html): Symlink jails (`fs.realpathSync`), DNS-verified SSRF protection (`169.254.169.254`), read-only `node:sqlite`, and `crypto.timingSafeEqual` HMAC verification.
- [Why Headless Browser Scrapers Burn Compute: Building 174ms Zero-Browser Apify Actors](https://danlopes18-ctrl.github.io/guides/zero-browser-apify-actors-rag-b2b.html): Architecture and benchmarks for zero-browser Node.js 22 Apify Actors for RAG, llms.txt audits, GitHub velocity, RSS monitoring, and B2B lead enrichment.
